comparison.scope: One sequential diagnostic run per frontend over the same actual native backend and source. No concurrent tests/builds/samplers. Identical per-phase initial/final camera transforms and complete drill actions/declaration count; not a field percentile or a stable speedup estimate.

baseline.methodology: Real GUI pointer/wheel/click events with CDP dispatch spans and sampled CPU profiles. Input-to-two-rAF is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or INP. Nested trace spans overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Profiling and automation add overhead; one controlled desktop run is not a field percentile.

validation.scope: All 76 distinct GUI journeys have passing actual outcomes across the full run and affected recovery. The earlier failed full-run exit remains recorded; this does not claim a single clean 76-case run.

report.scope: Same-process comparative algorithm gate, not browser paint/INP or a native compilation budget. OS caches are warm; nine alternating paired measurements. Absolute timings are diagnostic only.

performance_gate.concurrency_scope: Relative same-process algorithm gate ran alongside the three browser recovery journeys; this is not an isolated absolute timing benchmark.
